text: Business Administration is a comprehensive discipline that studies the operational management principles of enterprises, organizations or institutions, focusing on how to achieve organizational goals (such as profitability, social value, etc.) through scientific decision-making, efficient resource allocation and effective organizational coordination. It integrates knowledge from multiple fields such as economics, management, psychology, and law. It not only pays attention to macro-level strategic planning but also involves micro-level daily operations. It is the core discipline for cultivating "business managers" and "organizational leaders".
